title: Safehouse 4B
briefing: A defector under agency protection was taken from a safehouse apartment. The handler blames a compromised courier. Two minutes, two bags. The apartment is already being stripped.

truthEvents.text: 19:00 Handler Dana Reyes moves defector Ilya Marek into the safehouse.
19:45 Reyes blinds the apartment's security camera from inside.
20:30 Reyes opens the door for the extraction team with her own keycard.
20:50 Reyes files a report blaming a compromised courier.

clues.name: Handwritten note
clues.description: "Stay away from the windows. Food in the fridge. - D" The handwriting is neat and quick.

clues.name: Grocery receipt
clues.description: 18:40, two dinners, two coffees. Paid in cash at the corner shop.

clues.name: Taped camera
clues.description: Black tape over the lens, applied from inside the room. The feed cut out at 19:45.

clues.name: Small screwdriver
clues.description: Left on the bookshelf under the camera. It carries an agency inventory tag signed out to D. Reyes.

clues.name: Door keycard log
clues.description: Lock panel memory: OPEN 20:29, card #R-12. Card R-12 belongs to the handler. No forced entry.

clues.name: Door frame
clues.description: Paint and wood intact. Whoever came in did not have to break anything.

clues.name: Laptop draft
clues.description: An incident report saved 20:52: "Breach via compromised courier." Written before the courier was ever questioned.

clues.name: Two coffee cups
clues.description: One cold, one still warm with a lipstick mark. Someone stayed behind after the door opened.
